instruction: Review a pull request that touches Playwright code for new defects, test-to-change fit and blast radius
relevant_when: A pull request changes spec files, page objects, fixtures or playwright.config.*
context: Block only on issues the pull request introduces. Pre-existing debt in touched files is reported separately and never blocks. A pull request must keep behavior changes and tests in step, and must state the blast radius of shared-code or config changes.

checklist.name: no-new-blocking-findings
checklist.rule: No critical or high scanner finding sits on a line the pull request added

checklist.name: legacy-debt-not-blocking
checklist.rule: Findings on unchanged lines are listed as informational legacy debt and do not change the verdict
checklist.relevant_when: A touched file contains pre-existing findings

checklist.name: behavior-change-has-test
checklist.rule: Application behavior changed by the pull request is covered by a new or updated test, or the description explains why not
checklist.relevant_when: The pull request changes application code or specs

checklist.name: test-fails-without-change
checklist.rule: A new test would fail without the change under test; the reviewer asks for evidence (run output, --repeat-each result) when stability is uncertain
checklist.relevant_when: The pull request adds a test

checklist.name: no-duplicate-helpers
checklist.rule: New page objects, fixtures or helpers do not duplicate an existing one
checklist.relevant_when: The pull request adds a helper, fixture or page object

checklist.name: config-blast-radius-stated
checklist.rule: Changes to retries, timeouts, workers, projects or shared fixtures state which specs are affected
checklist.relevant_when: playwright.config.* or a shared fixture changes

checklist.name: improvements-credited
checklist.rule: The review notes changes that remove existing findings so authors get credit for paying down debt
checklist.relevant_when: The pull request removes lines that earlier carried findings
